name: cloudflare-edge-platform
description: Comprehensive Cloudflare Workers platform with tracking, personalization, and experimentation

scripts.dev: npm run build:meridian && npm run build:sdk && wrangler dev
scripts.build: echo 'No build required for TypeScript with Cloudflare Workers'
scripts.lint: eslint src --ext .ts public/meridian/meridian.js public/meridian/surfaces.js public/meridian/beats.js public/meridian/compare.js public/meridian/layout.js public/meridian/moments.js public/sdk/debug.js --max-warnings 582
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.gate: GATE_JSON=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/cfbase-gate-vitest.json; node --max-old-space-size=4096 node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --incremental false --composite false && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p src/sdk/tsconfig.json --noEmit && { node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1 --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile=$GATE_JSON || true; } && node scripts/remediation/score.mjs --from $GATE_JSON --check-ratchet && node scripts/remediation/score.mjs --from $GATE_JSON --check --typecheck green && node scripts/build-sdk.mjs --check && node scripts/build-meridian.mjs --check && npm run lint
scripts.optly-entity-flags: node optly-npx-fix.cjs optly entity templates flag
scripts.optly-entity-experiments: node optly-npx-fix.cjs optly entity templates experiment
scripts.optly-entity-audiences: node optly-npx-fix.cjs optly entity templates audience
